scope: All929 BenchLS reused development, morphology mechanism experiment. No new trained variant or semantic labels. No SWORDS/TSAR/reserved-domain use.
source_change: Only known incompatible verb lemmas with one dictionary-supported exact WordNet alternative. Keep equivalent inventories, POS, tense, thresholds and floor.
baseline: Frozen 52-feature contextual model with corrected entity guard
training: Reconstruct frozen baseline OOF models on original candidate rows only, target-word groups and saved folds. Repaired candidates never enter training. Verify baseline probabilities at 1e-12.
selection: Native regenerate both repaired cases from corrected lemma. Original candidates/scores and order retained on unchanged cases. Fresh guards for changed cases; corrected guard cache elsewhere.
native_checks: Compare raw and native repair decisions for all929. Raw/native verb inventories for all repaired lemmas. Regenerated candidate origin IDs exact. Batch-vs-single feature matrices and replacement similarities on each repaired case, no label-selected checks.
adoption: Mean default net gain >=5 AND strict precision >=.90/coverage >=.20 every repeat. No logloss comparison on changed populations. Keep opt-in; never auto-save/promote.
guard_snapshot: Same supplied-baseline corrected entity guard for both policies. Explicit guard-source.py matches guard scan SHA256, isolating concurrent literal protection work.
context_split: Preserve historical target-word folds and verify no repaired row shares its target group OR normalized full sentence with training rows. No new variant training.
